CANONICAL EO OPTION B (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-06 16:25Z, per Greg via Engram::Asistant #569 and #574: „EO nie mialo tego uzywac, mialo sprawdzac tylko stan przed i PO wariant B ABY ... TO UPROSCIC”; „prosze o sprawdzenie memory, dokumentow ZAPISANIE POPRAWNEGO WARIANTU”). This supersedes every earlier option-B text, including the 05:52Z text with point (4) "the file watcher can only DISQUALIFY", and all watcher, H3, .git/info and source-v2 decisions of 2026-11-06.
A committed declared test command earns credit when, and only when:
1. BEFORE: before the turn's prompt is dispatched, the existing source_id (rev 5) of the session's named root is clean at commit X (S0; bounded, and on expiry the turn still runs, uncredited, with a named reason).
2. The declared command from the committed termal-tests.toml is the turn's first tool action, with original execution identity.
3. AFTER: after the run, the existing source_id is clean at the same X.
4. The test's own result artifact, as it stood at END, decides pass or fail.
5. The result goes out as the existing verification_record_v1.
NOTHING ELSE: no watcher events (they neither grant nor refuse credit), no .git/info hashes or comparisons, no `engram source` v2 or submodule scope list (v1 stays).
Accepted, documented limits: a change fully reverted between BEFORE and AFTER, or one git status does not report (.git/info edits, hidden index flags), is not detected.
Rule: no new conditions, mechanisms or gates on this model without Greg's explicit word. Work item: w-24a72c898d6d (criterion 3 revised to match, coding as v13 by Sol-03d4). Source-id unification: w-6f42c416b0c7, v1 only.
